description.narrative: To support the non-bank lending companies in Indonesia, which are FMO customers, Bina Artha Ventura (BAV) and Mitra Bisnis Keluarga (MBK), to assess ways in which to create an enabling environment for financial companies that are engaged in lending to MSMEs. For that purpose FMO will contribute to the hiring of MSC Global Consulting Pte. Ltd. (MSC) who will conduct a comparative analysis of regulatory frameworks for lending companies that can be utilized to inform The Financial Services Authority of Indonesia (OJK) on how to develop a robust, supportive and actionable regulatory framework for non-bank lending companies in the country with a focus on those that provide working capital loans to microenterprises.
